pages.title: Thrusters and Engines
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Thrusters** burn piped liquid fuel, throttled by redstone. Wrong fluid, no thrust.
- **Solid Fuel Thrusters** are the easy start: coal, charcoal, planks.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Ion Thrusters** run on Forge energy.
- All need Aeronautics physics to be useful.
Create Propulsion: Simulated adds engines for ships: fuel thrusters, electric ion thrusters, steerable vector thrusters, wings and heat engines. They need Aeronautics physics to be useful.

pages.title: Thruster
pages.text: Burns liquid fuel piped in, throttled by redstone. An oxidizer adds an efficiency bonus. Build 2x2 or 3x3 blocks of them. Pipe fuel into the end opposite the flame.

pages.title: Fuels
pages.text:
Thrusters accept:

- Turpentine (from Pine Resin)
- TFMG diesel, gasoline, kerosene and naphtha
- Northstar's hydrocarbon, methane, biofuel and liquid hydrogen

**Wrong fluid means no thrust.** See [#](2E5AAC)[Oil](entry://industry/tfmg_oil)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Rockets](entry://space/rocket_building)[#]().

pages.title: Solid Fuel Thruster
pages.text: Burns items instead of fluid: coal, charcoal, wood or Blaze Cake. Easy to start with, since coal, charcoal and planks all work.

pages.title: Feeding it in flight
pages.text:
Holds one fuel item at a time. A coal lasts about 3 minutes at full power, longer at low power.\
\
Right-click it with a Wrench to open its hatch. Then it pulls its next item by itself from a chest or other container against its intake end (opposite the flame).

pages.title: Ion Thruster
pages.text: Runs on Forge energy rather than fuel. Stores energy; generators can feed it from below. See [#](2E5AAC)[Electricity](entry://industry/electricity)[#]().

pages.title: Vector Thruster
pages.text: Tilts to push in any direction under redstone control. Needs platinum, which this mod adds as an ore.

pages.title: Wing
pages.text: Plain wing blocks. Smelt one to get a Tempered Wing. [#](7A3C9A)[Copycat](entry://glossary/copycat)[#]() versions copy another block's look.

pages.title: Stirling Engine
pages.text: Makes rotation from heat below it. Solid and Liquid Burners supply that heat. They can warm a [#](7A3C9A)[boiler](entry://glossary/boiler)[#]() but can't heat mixers or superheat anything; that still takes a [#](2E5AAC)[Blaze Burner](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]().

pages.title: Smaller parts
pages.text: [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Redstone Transmission changes speed from a signal, either directly or step by step. Tilt Adapters turn a left/right difference into an angle. [#](2E5AAC)[Hold W](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() over the Stirling Engine and burners for their Ponders.
